signal: On an eligible US equity session, at 09:29 America/New_York, BTC's last fully completed 1-minute close at or before 09:28 ET is at least 2.00% above BTC's last 1-minute close at or before 15:59 ET on MSTR's preceding eligible US session. Both BTC observations must be no more than five minutes stale; otherwise do not trade.

execution.entry: Buy MSTR at that session's regular-hours opening auction (09:30 ET).
execution.exit: Sell the whole position at that same session's regular-hours closing auction (16:00 ET).
execution.position_sizing: One independent long-only position; no leverage, no shorting, no overlapping holding periods because holding period is same-day.
execution.availability: The signal uses no equity opening price and is complete before the entry auction.

selection_note: Development-only selection: 2020-08-13 to 2022-12-30; chosen from the stable 1.5%/2.0% neighborhood with positive calendar-year development results and 138 trade days at 2.0%.
